title: cloud/sandbox survived 3r2's GOES list and the epic's acceptance criteria; the deviation lives only in a code comment
body: Tick 3r2's GOES list and the epic's acceptance criteria both say cloud/sandbox is deleted; the integrated branch still carries it (Dockerfile, entrypoint.sh, worker.sh, common.sh, preflight.sh — the 236K build context). The worker kept it for a real reason (internal/sandbox still shells into its scripts to warm local worktrees, and internal/sandbox itself was never in delete scope), but the deviation is recorded only in a comment in embedded.go — no tick note, no finding — and the review's survival checklist never re-checked the acceptance criteria, so the epic record claims a deletion that did not happen. Decide on the record: finish the deletion (move the scripts where internal/sandbox can reach them, or into ticfac) or amend the epic record to state why it stays.
